description: Six need criteria scored 0-5 where 5 is the most favourable to an AI short-film workflow, plus three gates that are applied BEFORE any score is considered.

rules.speed_value_note: 5 if turnaround <= 5 days, 3 if 6-15 days, 1 above 15 days - fast iteration is where AI production pays

gates.ai_appropriate: Would AI-generated imagery be acceptable to the audience at all? A factual statement by a real person fails.
gates.rights_cleared: Are rights, regulator or licence approvals in place? 'pending' is UNKNOWN, which means HOLD.
gates.likeness_consent: Does the film use a real person's face or voice without documented consent? That fails, whatever the score.

workflow_patterns.all_in_one_agent: One photo + one structured prompt -> finished short drama. Fastest; least shot-level control; good for social volume and quick drafts.
workflow_patterns.multi_tool_pipeline: Planner LLM -> image model (references, keyframes) -> video model -> voice -> music -> editor. Most control and consistency; most steps.
workflow_patterns.hybrid_local: Cloud generation for hero shots; local open models, QA, grading and edit on a workstation. Best for privacy, repeatable series and cost control.
